title: Viva Engage: broadcast, meeting-based and custom events with moderated questions and anonymous posting
summary: The briefing correctly reports the December 7 legacy event creation deadline and the documented Teams controls, without presenting them as confirmed Engage controls. The updated setup requirements still support its Core licensing statements. One minor qualification remains: the Teams events PowerShell reference labels the policy as preview.
